messages:
Ava: Heads-up — we need to lock a 60m design review for the new unified client auth flow (API + SDK + Console). Need cross-team reviewers and a short pre-read. Proposing two slots: Wed 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 16:00–17:00 PT. Which works?
Jon: I can do Thu 16:00 PT. prefer later in week.
Rohit: Wed 10:00 PT works for me if we keep it tight.
Maya: Thu is better for me. Can we confirm duration and scope?
Ava: Goal: review API contract changes, SDK auth helpers, and Console UX for token management. 60m total: 10m context, 25m walkthrough (API+SDK), 15m Console UX, 10m open Q&A.
Ava: Pre-read (please skim before meeting): https://redwood.dev/docs/priv/auth-unified-draft — includes API proto, SDK example snippets, Console mockups. Leave comments in that doc.
Ava: Quick pre-read checklist (please reply with your initials when done):
- read API contract section
- run SDK snippet locally (README has i/o)
- check Console mockups for edge cases
- note any rollout/compat concerns

Rohit: I can review SDK code samples. Assign me as SDK reviewer. will run the snippet tonight.
Jon: I'll take API contract review. Quick Q: are we changing error codes? That impacts client libs.
Ava: Yes — adding 2 new error codes (401.2 = token_revoked, 401.3 = token_refresh_failed). We'll document mapping in SDK.
Maya: I can do Console mocks + accessibility checklist. Will add comments to the mockups by EOD.
Kai: Heads-up from infra: can we flag whether this needs canary routing? If so, we should include rollout policy in the agenda.
Ava: Good call. Adding a 5min canary discussion at the end. Also want to confirm owners for follow-ups: API — Jon, SDK — Rohit, Console — Maya, Rollout — Kai.
Jon: noted. Also pinging @deploy-bot for current PR/CI status on the SDK branch.
deploy-bot: SDK auth branch CI status: 3/5 checks passed, flaky test infra/credentials-setup failing. Link: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/5523
Rohit: I'll re-run the flaky test and push a fix branch if needed.
Maya: If Thu wins, can we get an invite with timezone-converted times? I have EMEA folks who want to join.
Ava: Will post a Doodle + send calendar invites once we have majority. Doodle link: https://doodle.com/poll/unified-auth-review
Jon: +1 for Thu if EMEA is involved.
Rohit: if Thu, i might be late by 10 mins (timezone stuff). that's fine.
Ava: OK majority seems to prefer Thu 16:00 PT. Locking that for now — will send invite and include the pre-read checklist in the invite body.
Maya: doing pre-read now — will drop notes by EOD.
Kai: I'll prepare a short rollout playbook slide (canary + fallback) and drop in the shared doc before meeting.
Ava: Thanks all. If you haven't marked the pre-read checklist, please do so by tomorrow 12:00 PT. Agenda (to paste in invite):
```
1) 10m — Context & goals (Ava)
2) 25m — API changes walkthrough (Jon) + SDK impact (Rohit)
3) 15m — Console UX walkthrough & accessibility notes (Maya)
4) 5m — rollout/canary plan (Kai)
5) 5m — action items & next steps
```
Ava: Ping me in thread if you find anything blocking in the pre-read. :thumbsup:
Jon: LGTM — will add a quick diff summary to the API section.
Rohit: SDK run succeeded locally after minor tweak; will update examples.
Maya: added accessibility notes + a11y screenshots.
deploy-bot: Reminder: create meeting on calendar once Ava posts invite.
Ava: Invite sent to the group and external reviewers (PM, Security). Calendar shows Thu 16:00 PT / Fri 00:00 CEST. Meeting link and doc included.
Jon: added a short list of compatibility tests to the doc.
Rohit: assigned myself as reviewer on the SDK PR and left a comment about token mapping.
Maya: can we add a quick demo in Console section? 5min video clip maybe.
Ava: Yes — please upload to the doc or drop an mp4 link in the thread.
Maya: uploaded demo gif to the doc.
Jon: all set from API side, no blockers.
Rohit: CI green now. will merge after approvals.
Kai: rollout slide uploaded. will sync with infra on canary windows.
Ava: Thanks everyone — see you Thu. :rocket:
